mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points month-over-month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals strengthening demand, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST shows a sustained increase over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic output, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the real GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a contracting economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and GDPC1 growth is negative.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.1 percentage points month-over-month, it signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.1pp MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS decreases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 0.5% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.2 percentage points month-over-month, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE increases > 0.2pp MoM
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 0.5% MoM and UNRATE increases by more than 0.2pp MoM.
